You're invited

Moody's Holiday Gift Giving Party

Richard Moody's December tradition in Uptown. Bring an unwrapped gift, give back, celebrate the season.

WhenMon, Dec 14, 2026
7:00 PM – 11:00 PM
WhereGranada Theater
3022 Hennepin Ave., Minneapolis, MN 55408

Richard Moody's annual holiday party returns to the Granada Theater in Uptown Minneapolis on Monday, December 14, from 7 to 11 p.m. Come celebrate the season with friends, neighbors, models, business partners and supporters.

Please bring a new, unwrapped gift. Teens are often forgotten in holiday drives, so gifts for teenagers are especially welcome. Cash donations are also accepted, and everything collected goes to Twin Cities kids, teens and families.

Parking: street parking and the Calhoun Square (7 Corners) ramp are suggested.
